***With 30 years’ experience, James Atha joins AECOM to lead the function across core markets***


**LONDON** (16 November 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced it has established an executive architecture service offering for clients across all sectors in the UK and Ireland. The company has appointed James Atha to establish and lead the function, with responsibility for overseeing its strategic direction, driving growth and technical excellence.


Mr. Atha joins AECOM from Veretec, where he was a board director responsible for delivering large, complex and multi-phased projects, including residential, commercial office, mixed-use, retail, leisure and transport schemes both in the UK and internationally.


“Establishing an executive architecture function enables AECOM to better support clients in turning conceptual designs into buildable realities,” said Jo Streeten, Managing Director, Buildings & Places at AECOM. “By strengthening our technical architectural capabilities and embedding a deeper understanding of construction stages, we can help ensure major schemes are both viable and deliverable, even in an increasingly challenging economic environment. To drive this forward, I am delighted to welcome James Atha as Studio Lead for Executive Architecture. His proven ability to deliver large, complex projects has established him as a respected leader in the sector and he will be a tremendous asset to AECOM”.


“There are myriad factors that architects, contractors and developers must consider to ensure the building that is delivered reflects the original design intent,” said James Atha, Studio Lead for Executive Architecture UK & Ireland, AECOM. “Executive architecture helps clients make informed decisions around cost, quality, risk and, ultimately, buildability. What excites me most about joining AECOM is the opportunity to bring this passion and expertise to the business, integrating it with AECOM’s global, multi-disciplinary capabilities across the built environment. I also look forward to reconnecting with clients across the London commercial sector and beyond.”


Across the UK and Ireland, AECOM’s Architecture & Urbanism practice works across public and private sectors, delivering award-winning design solutions spanning commercial, residential, transport, defence, healthcare, education, and major mixed-use environments.


The announcement follows AECOM’s recent move to strengthen its London market offering through the creation of a new combined cost and project management team.


*James Atha, Studio Lead for Executive Architecture UK & Ireland, AECOM*


**About AECOM**


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.
